Do not invent a visible rear panel/window/door/seam, duplicate the service face or move hidden hardware onto a visible face. Hidden panels remain on the original physical side. Hull stays upright, never tilted toward a heading arrow, never flat-image mirrored/rotated.

Preserve exact selected compact joined rounded-ogive capsule and one cylindrical tank, ONE integrated graphite engine bell and EXACTLY FOUR short graphite landing feet in square/cardinal arrangement. Rear feet may physically occlude, but don't duplicate hardware to show them.

Uniform reduction for clearance is allowed. No other model/view, ground/floor patch/external cast shadow, scenery/backdrop/platform/stand, frame/magenta/guide/cross/colored box, text/label/number/logo, booster/antenna/fin, people, cargo/probe/pod, exhaust/smoke/glow, road/rail/water. READY with original feet deployed. Final SW: original panels fully hidden REAR-LEFT, plain cream hull, one ochre band, one bell, original FOUR feet only.
